description: Reusable authored-pose direction for chemist player identities. Identity details always come from player-variants.json and the staged portrait; this profile supplies only class motion and continuity rules.

style.authority: Pixel density, outline language, compact tactical proportions, lighting, and material rendering only. The style image must never override the selected identity portrait or player metadata.

identity.motionStyle: precise, careful, calculated, resourceful, and brisk, with protective handling of fragile supplies and readable reach, throw, and recovery mechanics
identity.equipmentRule: Keep the authoritative portrait's apron, pouches, bottles, vials, tools, and accessories recognizable and consistent in every pose. For an attack, move exactly one existing throwable vial from its holder to the hand and then into flight; never show that same vial in two places, duplicate supplies, add a weapon, or transform permanent gear.
identity.magicRule: All active effects are physical alchemy originating from the chemist's single handled vial. Use compact liquid, smoke, foam, or spark reactions in the identity portrait's established chemical palette; never add arcane spell-casting, runes, summoned energy, or unexplained magical aura.

promptTemplates.reference: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: canonical full-body game character reference for a 16-bit fantasy tactical RPG. Image 1 is the authoritative {{displayName}} identity portrait; Image 2 is the approved full-body pixel-art style and proportion reference only. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Create one complete head-to-toe {{displayName}} that faithfully preserves Image 1's face, ancestry traits, gender presentation, hair, eyes, complexion, practical costume, apron, palette, proportions, vials, pouches, and tools. Do not import identity details from Image 2. {{equipmentRule}} Translate the portrait into the compact full-body quality and clever readable silhouette demonstrated by Image 2. Use a {{background}} background with no floor or scenery. Use a square 1:1 canvas with generous padding on every side. Polished hand-authored 16-bit pixel art with crisp intentional pixel clusters, bold dark outlines, restrained warm top-left highlights, and muted watercolor-and-parchment color ramps. One centered full-body chemist in an alert supplies-protecting ready stance facing {{baseFacing}}. {{invariants}}
promptTemplates.animation: Draw exactly {{frameCount}} genuinely redrawn full-body {{actionLabel}} poses of the authoritative {{displayName}} in a {{columns}}-column by {{rows}}-row atlas, ordered top row left-to-right and then bottom row left-to-right. Player identity metadata: {{visualTraits}}. Required sequence: {{frameSequence}}. Motion direction: {{motionDirection}}. Overall chemist motion is {{motionStyle}}. {{poseRequirement}} Preserve the exact portrait identity, practical costume, apron, palette, proportions, and equipment throughout. {{equipmentRule}} {{magicRule}} Action-specific effects: {{effectRule}} Use a {{background}} background with generous gutters between complete head-to-toe poses. {{invariants}}

idle.motionDirection: An alert breathing loop alternates between checking secured supplies and scanning the field, with careful hand placement, small weight shifts, and a smooth return to the first pose.
idle.effectRule: No active reaction or loose projectile; only a tiny contained liquid glint is permitted inside an existing closed vial.

measured inhale while eyes and shoulders scan upward
weight shift forward as the free hand checks a secured bottle
brief analytical lean with apron and pouch straps responding
centered observant midpoint with all supplies secured
measured exhale while the free hand withdraws
weight shift rearward as attention scans the opposite side
alert supplies-protecting stance flowing back to frame one

walk.motionDirection: A cautious but brisk alternating-contact walk with real knee compression, passing poses, one hand stabilizing fragile supplies, free-arm counter-motion, and controlled apron and pouch follow-through.
walk.effectRule: No active chemical reaction or loose flask; all vials remain closed and secured while straps, apron, and hair respond to the walk.

left leg compression with bottles kept upright

attack.motionDirection: A calculated throw moves from target assessment through a precise reach, single-vial draw, full-body windup, stepping release, compact chemical impact, follow-through, and supplies-secured recovery.
attack.effectRule: Show exactly one thrown vial and one compact physical chemical burst at impact, using liquid, smoke, foam, or sparks from that vial only. Never show the vial both held and airborne or obscure the throwing hand and body mechanics.
frameDescriptions: calculating ready stance while sighting the target
throwing hand reaches precisely toward one secured vial
exactly one existing vial drawn into the hand with no duplicate left in its holder
deep overhand windup with opposite foot planted and free arm aiming
committed forward step releasing the single vial into a short arc
compact chemical burst at vial impact as the throwing arm follows through
body decelerates while the free hand steadies remaining supplies
recovered alert stance with permanent gear secured

hurt.motionDirection: A sudden hit causes an articulated flinch, maximum startled stagger, scrambling backward step, protective clutch over fragile supplies, low balance catch, inventory check, and wary recovery.
hurt.effectRule: Use only a compact physical impact accent; no gore, blood, full-body tint, magic, broken bottle, duplicated vial, or uncontrolled cloud.

sharp startled flinch with arms lifting defensively
maximum stagger with torso recoiling and apron swinging

recovered alert supplies-protecting stance

death.motionDirection: A decisive impact overwhelms the chemist, supplies are instinctively gathered close, knees buckle into a seated drop, the torso tips into a careful sideward collapse, reaches full ground contact, and settles into an unmistakable fully fallen rest pose.
death.effectRule: No gore, blood, dismemberment, magic, explosion, duplicated equipment, or rigid rotation of the upright sprite. Keep bottles and permanent gear recognizable and attached through the grounded collapse.

arms draw supplies close as balance fails
knees buckle into a low seated drop
one hip grounds while the torso tips sideways
body reaches full ground contact with gear still attached
low fallen body settles with limbs clearly articulated
final fully fallen chemist pose with secured equipment at rest

victory.motionDirection: The chemist confirms success, inspects one selected vial, raises it with sudden inspiration, performs a careful celebratory hop, presents a tiny controlled reaction, catches balance, lifts the vial proudly, and holds a clever triumphant finish.
victory.effectRule: One selected handheld vial may produce a tiny contained puff, fizz, or sparkle in its established chemical palette; never duplicate the vial, create a spell, or let the reaction hide the hands or face.
